testcase.name: Scenario: Stage a separator from a category with no macro commands: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:850:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Stage a separator from a category with no macro commands ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows an empty Part Tools target ✔ And the Macros category has no macro commands available in this session ✔ When the user selects the Macros command category ✔ Then the available list shows only "<Separator>" ✔ And the custom panel list remains empty ✔ When the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available list ✔ Then a separator appears in the custom panel list ✔ And "<Separator>" remains in the available list ✔ And the target is marked as changed ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
